description: Per-item clamp agreement analysis. For each question_idx in the routing-cell bootstrap JSON, classifies whether clamp_both(lambda=2) restores item-level behavior (both framings up to leading accuracy), homogenizes (both collapse to trailing accuracy), shows mixed pattern, or leaves a persistent gap. Gap closed threshold: |clamp_gap| <= 0.2. Informative baseline gap threshold: >= 0.1.
